_comment: Reviewed divergence between the Python and TypeScript public surfaces.
The BDD scenario fails when the real divergence stops matching this file,
so a name can only appear or disappear here deliberately.
Regenerate intentionally; do not paste over a failure.
The directional backlog is `kv`, `actor` and `mailbox`, whose initial
guest SDK surfaces are Python-only. `actor` uses the lifecycle broker;
`mailbox` uses the dedicated encrypted mailbox channel, not that broker.
TypeScript counterparts with equivalent contract coverage close these
entries. The other two categories describe differences rather than debt.
runtime type information TypeScript erases before the program runs, and
`SecretInArgWarning` is a warning type JavaScript does not have. Both are
properties of the languages, not gaps in the SDK.
`export type`, which tsc erases, so a runtime surface check cannot see
RecoveryRequiredDetails is a frozen, keyword-only Python dataclass;
TypeScript exports its readonly shape as a type, not a constructor.
